bio_md:
# 建文帝朱允炆 · 主要事迹

朱允炆（1377—1402），[[ming-tai-zu|太祖]]之孙，太子朱标之子。洪武三十一年（1398）太祖崩，允炆即位，改元建文。

建文帝用齐泰、黄子澄、方孝孺等，行宽仁之政，锐意削藩：周、齐、湘、代、岷诸王先后被废，矛头直指燕王[[ming-cheng-zu|朱棣]]。建文元年（1399）朱棣以「靖难」为名起兵北平，四年南下，建文四年（1402）兵入南京，宫中火起，建文帝下落不明——「逊国」之谜流传至今，或云焚死，或云削发为僧云游。

建文四年之政本为宽仁，惜削藩操之过急，以速祸亡；其下落不明与成祖夺位，为明初第一大公案。

bio_parts_en.value:
and son of Crown Prince Biao, took the throne in 1398, era Jianwen.

With Qi Tai, Huang Zicheng, and Fang Xiaoru he governed with leniency and pressed the reduction of the feudal princes: Zhou, Qi, Xiang, Dai, and Min were stripped in turn, the sword aimed at the Prince of Yan,

. In 1399 Zhu Di rose in the "Jingnan" war from Beiping; in 1402 his armies entered Nanjing, fire rose in the palace, and the Jianwen emperor vanished - burned, some say, or fled as a tonsured wanderer. The mystery outlives the dynasty.

Four years of benevolent rule undone by haste; his disappearance and Chengzu's usurpation form the first great case of the Ming.
